info.name: Festival of Lights - Building the Altar

descriptions.notStarted: Hmm, that woman looks like she's preparing some sort of celebration... I should check it out.
descriptions.inProgress: I spoke with Hannah, and she's preparing a Festival of Lights. I've agreed to help her build the Altar by gathering 25 Altar Pieces. She mentioned that the monsters would already have an axe stuck in them, so I should hunt those.
descriptions.completed: I collected the 25 Altar Pieces and returned to Hannah. She was happy, and began building the Altar. She also mentioned that I could come back for more work when I have a chance
